card: Full sprite-frame pixel art in a contemporary indie technique (Backbone, NORCO, The Last Night, Eastward): a genuine pixel grid, limited palette, dithered shading, no vector or cel-shaded linework, no anti-aliasing. Grounded, realistic London colour: vivid where the real city is vivid (brick red, bus and pillar-box red, shopfront paint, park green), restrained elsewhere. Not neon, not fantasy-saturated, not dark noir, not flat grey. Gold is reserved for calc and currency. No legible text or logos unless the shot needs them.
